performance_engine: NautilusTrader 1.230.0 via the existing candidate-02 run_window path

first_week.selection_method: deterministic shuffle of eligible Monday weeks inside direct-data coverage after excluding every previously revealed candidate-02 week

causal_question: When aggressive flow reaches an external 30-minute auction boundary, is liquidity in front of it being withdrawn so price discovery can continue, or replenished so the impact is absorbed and the auction rotates?

mutually_exclusive_modes.setup: large completed three-minute aggressive flow, above-median turnover, efficient price impact, external boundary break, same-side one-percent depth withdrawal and stable/replenishing opposite depth
mutually_exclusive_modes.confirmation: first completed one-minute retest that touches and holds outside the frozen boundary with supportive flow/book imbalance
mutually_exclusive_modes.invalidation: back inside the frozen boundary by 0.15 ATR

mutually_exclusive_modes.setup: large completed three-minute aggressive flow, above-median turnover, inefficient price impact, external boundary sweep and same-side one-percent depth replenishment
mutually_exclusive_modes.confirmation: first completed one-minute close back inside the frozen boundary with failed flow or opposing book imbalance
mutually_exclusive_modes.invalidation: beyond the observed impact extreme by 0.15 ATR

causality.direct_observation_cutoff: all aggTrades and book snapshots are restricted to the completed minute
causality.adaptive_threshold_rule: all adaptive thresholds use shift(1) before rolling quantiles
causality.boundary_rule: boundary high/low excludes the setup minute
causality.order_release_rule: orders are submitted only at a completed confirmation-minute timestamp

promotion_rule: Only a mode satisfying every first-week gate can be frozen unchanged before a new second BTC week is selected and collected. Failed frequency, direction, reward geometry or drawdown ends the mode without parameter search.
